$Comment: Working at a station. One unit per REAL completed work cycle of an attended session; an idle-practice cycle (working with nothing to work on) does not count. The Target is a station id, the lower-cased filename of the station's own asset (this jar's mill is 'sawmill'), not the block's item id; leave the Target off to count cycles at any station. The Icon is the picture a step gets when its target has none of its own, and TargetIcons pairs a station id with the block it is worked at, so a step naming this jar's mill is drawn with the mill. A pack adding a station can ship its own copy of this file with one more TargetIcons row; the leaves merge over this one, nothing else needs restating.
